training_split: fixed hash order; first min(20, floor(unique WAV count/2)) for enrollment; rest for queries; exclude labels without disjoint audio, enrollment vowels or a query with five vowels; no replacement
negative_sampling: uniform distinct label within the same corpus; genuine and impostor share one phone mask
selection: lowest equal-corpus mean validation verification EER; earliest update breaks ties; update zero eligible
evaluation: same existing enrollment/query indices and five-vowel gate as the frozen encoder study; all six models and per-corpus validation FAR1pct thresholds frozen before test scoring
interpretation: one prespecified frozen 280-label encoder and three fusion seeds; all test data previously observed; improvement not guaranteed
